Lina (Support): FYI ticket H-3241 from Helios Health. They ran the usage CSV export after our manual backfill and see an extra day (2025-11-09) showing 0 tokens in the CSV, but the invoice shows ~548k tokens for that day. Customer is asking why CSV != invoice. Can someone triage?

Sophie (Support): attaching the snippet they pasted into the portal. They said the portal dashboard and invoice both show tokens for 2025-11-09, only the export is missing the rows.

Sophie (Support): ```
date,customer_id,model,tokens
2025-11-08,helios-001,gpt-xx,42123
2025-11-09,helios-001,gpt-xx,0
2025-11-10,helios-001,gpt-xx,50234
```

Michael (Billing): I see invoice line: 2025-11-09 -> 548,173 tokens billed (charged). Our daily ledger aggregate also shows 548,173 for that customer/day. So the billing pipeline has the tokens, export is missing them. Could be backfill export dedupe or a filter.

Ashish (Infra): looking at backfill job logs (s3://redwood-backfills/helios/2025-11-09/run-7/logs). Quick grep: ``write_row(customer=helios-001,date=2025-11-09): SKIPPED duplicate_key collision shard=4 key="helios-001|2025-11-09|gpt-xx|<hash>"``

backfill-bot: Backfill job run-7 completed 2025-11-10T04:12Z - status=completed warnings=2 skipped_writes=1

Tara (Eng): That log line suggests the backfill write path is deduping on a key that can collide across replay runs. For manual backfills we replay raw ledger rows but don't set a stable ingestion_run_id, so dedupe_key collapsed multiple sets into one and the export worker filters out rows marked as 'replay_skipped'.

Tara (Eng): repro plan: 1) run the ledger query to count raw rows for 2025-11-09 2) run the export tool in dry-run to see which rows are filtered 3) inspect dedupe ids for collisions.

Sophie (Support): ledger query the billing folks suggested: ```
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_sum FROM raw_usage
WHERE customer_id='helios-001' AND date='2025-11-09' GROUP BY customer_id;
```

Michael (Billing): Running that against ledger-analytics returns tokens_sum = 548173 (matches invoice). So raw data exists. Export pipeline must be dropping them during export.

Ashish (Infra): digging deeper - export worker marks rows with header `write_status` and sets `write_status=skipped_replay_collision` when dedupe_key already exists. Sample from export worker debug: ```
{row_id: "r-xxxxx", customer: "helios-001", date: "2025-11-09", tokens: 548173, write_status: "skipped_replay_collision"}
```

Tara (Eng): Root cause hypothesis: backfill replay generated rows with different request_ids; existing dedupe logic uses a hashed key that doesn't include ingestion_run_id, so the second replay hit the same dedupe hash and we skip writing the canonical export rows. We'll need to: a) change dedupe key to include ingestion_run_id b) add a forced-write flag for backfills c) run a one-off regen of that day's CSV for Helios.

Ashish (Infra): I can run a targeted regen now: `./infra/tools/exporter --customer helios-001 --date 2025-11-09 --force-write --output s3://support-attachments/helios/regen-2025-11-09.csv`

Sophie (Support): If you can push the regen result to that S3 path I will send corrected CSV to the customer and propose a billing credit if they want immediate adjustment.

Michael (Billing): Please cc billing@redwood when sending corrected CSV. If Helios wants a credit now we can issue a provisional credit while we fix the pipeline (adjustment will be reconciled once automatic fix is deployed).

Tara (Eng): I'll open PR to change dedupe key and add a new backfill flag. I'll add unit tests for ingest_run_id presence and e2e test that replays twice doesn't drop rows. ETA: PR by EOD PT, deploy early next week after review.

Ashish (Infra): I've kicked off the regen job, logs show success and file at s3://support-attachments/helios/regen-2025-11-09.csv (size 1.2MB). backfill-bot: attached checksum `sha256:fa3b...`

backfill-bot: Regeneration job exporter-regen-981 succeeded 2025-11-10T06:03Z -> s3://support-attachments/helios/regen-2025-11-09.csv

Sophie (Support): Sent corrected CSV and note to Helios. Told them root cause + tentative timeline for pipeline fix. Customer replied: "thank you, please keep us posted" :thumbsup:

Lina (Support): created internal incident INC-2025-123 to track the fix and billing follow-up. Assigning to Tara (Eng) and Ashish (Infra). I'll thread updates in the ticket and notify the customer once fixed.

Michael (Billing): Will prepare provisional credit entry in case Helios requests immediate refund; will reconcile after pipeline fix.

Tara (Eng): next steps: PR -> review -> canary deploy (export staging) -> verify regen for a different customer -> rollout. I'll post PR link here when ready.

Lina (Support): thanks everyone — keeping ticket open until post-deploy verification.
